purpose: Three word-memory illustration samples for the compact UX prototype; not a complete course asset collection.
visualCheck: Each output inspected for subject, coherent family style, readable silhouette, absence of text or background; PNG alpha channel confirmed.
limitations: Prototype samples only for three lesson-04 nouns; other words have no illustration in this prototype.
Illustrations support recognition at introduction and after answering, and must be hidden while testing recall.
AI-generated people illustrate a family concept rather than any real individual.

assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational, illustration-story.
Asset type: one compact transparent word-memory illustration for a Japanese-learning indie game.
Primary request: teach the concept FATHER through a warm human parent-child interaction. No words or labels.
Input images: image 1 is STYLE AND PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY — warm hand-painted Japanese room. Create an entirely new foreground illustration, do not reproduce that room.
Subject: a friendly Japanese father around 35, short dark brown hair, rolled-up cream shirt and muted sage vest, kneeling at a child's level, smiling warmly and gently resting his hand on the child's shoulder. One small child in ochre clothes looks up at him. Father occupies the clear visual emphasis; he must look like an adult father, not a grandfather or businessman. Human people, no cats.
Style: polished hand-painted storybook game sprite, subtle ink edges, soft gouache brushwork, tactile but clean, warm cream/ochre/sage colors, gentle expressive faces. Cohesive with the reference room.
Composition: compact near-square isolated group, large simple silhouette readable as a 64–120 px thumbnail, father and child fully visible, no cutoff body parts. Centered with narrow clear breathing room.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha everywhere outside the people. No paper rectangle, no card, no frame, no floor, no environment, no extra props, no checkerboard or painted fake transparency.
Constraints: no typography, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermarks or decorative labels. Do not render a room. One finished asset, no contact sheet.

Subject: the same friendly adult father with short tousled dark brown hair, cream shirt and sage vest; same adult mother with loosely tied dark brown hair, sage cardigan and terracotta skirt; their young boy in ochre clothes and a second slightly younger daughter in a muted cream and rose dress. Style: same polished hand-painted Japanese indie game storybook sprite, delicate warm ink edges, soft gouache brushwork, cream/ochre/sage/terracotta palette, gentle expressive faces.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha everywhere outside the people. No room, floor, props, card, border, paper rectangle, decorative frame, checkerboard or fake transparency.
Constraints: no typography, letters, numbers, captions, logos or watermarks. One finished asset, no contact sheet.
